WORLDWIDE CURATION

EXPLORE OUR TRIPS

Attica

Athenian Twilight: An Exclusive Athens Evening Tour

Witness the transformation of Athens beneath the night sky. Enjoy a relaxed, exclusive evening drive past the illuminated Acropolis and panoramic city viewpoints, offering a quiet, majestic perspective of the capital.
Peloponnese

The Peloponnese Grandeur: Myths & History

A full-day private expedition through time. Marvel at the Peloponnese, Corinth Canal, walk the ancient citadel of Mycenae, explore the acoustics of Epidaurus, and stroll the romantic streets of Nafplio—all at your own pace.
Attica

The Athenian Riviera & Cape Sounion Sunset

Escape the city's hustle. Enjoy a scenic coastal drive in our luxury van, culminating at the majestic Temple of Poseidon just in time for Greece's most breathtaking sunset.
Personalized Vision & Unrivaled Expertise

The Travel Architects: Local Expertise

We believe your flights and hotels are just the canvas. We paint the picture. While you handle your basic bookings, our consultants step in to design the 'in-between'. From the optimal route between sights to securing the right time for a museum visit, we architect your days in Greece to be entirely stress-free

About Us
Global Network

The ViaR Second Opinion

Already planned your itinerary? Let a local expert review it. The internet is full of outdated advice and tourist traps. Through our unique Second Opinion service, we audit your plans, catch logistical errors, and suggest subtle tweaks that transform a good trip into an extraordinary, seamless experience.

Build your Tour
THE VIAR STANDARD

Luxury is not a price point. It is a level of service and a commitment to detail.

The Executive Fleet

Our privately owned, late-model Mercedes-Benz Van is a sanctuary on wheels. Featuring plush seating, climate control, complimentary Wi-Fi, and bottled water, it ensures your transit is as refined as your destination.

Your Local Insider

Your driver is more than a chauffeur; they are your local friend. While we don't act as licensed historical guides inside the monuments, we provide rich local context, dining recommendations, and insider tips along the way.

Uncompromising Safety & Punctuality

For the discerning traveler, time is the ultimate luxury. We pride ourselves on absolute punctuality, meticulously maintained vehicles, and professional driving standards that guarantee peace of mind

Experiences Worth Sharing

Authentic reflections from our distinguished guests.
